statement_en: For any neighborhood $U$ of the identity element $1_G$ in an LCA group $G$, there exists a set $K \subseteq \hat{G}$ such that if $\chi \in \hat{G} \setminus K$, then there exists $x \in U$ with $$\operatorname{Re}\chi(x)\leq 0.$$
key_techniques: properties of characters on LCA groups
compactness arguments in the dual group
callout_body: 对于LCA群$G$当中单位元$1_G$的任意邻域$U$存在$K \subseteq \hat{G}$使得如果$\chi \in \hat{G} - K$那么存在$x \in U$使得$\text{Re}\chi(x)\leq 0$.
